summary.headline: No in-scope gaps: this single-node relational-fundamentals curriculum teaches the one ml_data skill it shares with the market (SQL) thoroughly, while every other ≥30%-demanded skill — Python and the pandas/numpy/scikit-learn/pytorch/tensorflow/hugging-face stack, git/docker/kubernetes/aws, and the distributed/NoSQL data layer (bigquery, snowflake, spark, vector databases, dbt, airflow, ray) — is excluded by Rule 3 (cross-domain) or by the course's depth bound (which explicitly rules out distributed databases and NoSQL engines), so there is no partially-covered topic to extend.
